name: Lucas Oghigian
tagline: projects, findings, and corrections to them
lede: I am a student. I build trading research systems, agent tooling, and games. Everything below says what it actually is: how much of it is mine, whether it was ever run, and what it failed to prove.
forks_note: Three other repositories on my GitHub account (`odoo`, `dexter-` and `AIdvisor-Presidential-AI-Challenge-25-26`) are forks of other people's work and are not mine. One more, `ATLAS-Presidential-AI-Challenge`, is a competition entry I built with a teammate; roughly half of its 59 commits are mine.
